title: Cervical Post-Exertion
summary: As needed, right after yard work or demanding activity. Gentle traction to decompress the neck before a crash sets in. Stop if arm symptoms worsen.

steps.name: Gentle Neck Warm-Up
steps.cue: Slow, small nods, tilts and turns to prep for traction. Stay well short of end range, especially turning and looking up.

steps.name: Pettibon Traction — Door
steps.cue: Do right after the activity. Elbows and knees on door, pad under chin. Exhale, sink toward ~20% body weight; inhale, stand. Match your current PM rep count. Stop if arm symptoms worsen.

steps.name: Cervical Traction — Post Exertion
steps.cue: Do right after the activity, before any crash sets in. Lie on back, cup the skull, gentle lengthwise pull, release very slowly. Stop if arm symptoms worsen.
